title: Predicting and improving complex beer flavor through machine learning
meta: Michiel Schreurs, et al. · Nature Communications · 2024
summary: Gradient boosting models trained on chemical and sensory data from 250 beers plus 180,000 consumer reviews predict flavor and appreciation and reveal specific compounds that drive taste.

title: From Data to Draught: Modelling and Predicting Mixed-Culture Beer Fermentation Dynamics Using Autoregressive Recurrent Neural Networks
summary: Autoregressive recurrent neural networks capture the time-dependent dynamics of mixed-culture beer fermentation and forecast its trajectory better than static models.

title: Enhancing beer authentication, quality, and control assessment using non-invasive spectroscopy through bottle and machine learning modeling
meta: Harris, et al. · Journal of Food Science · 2025
summary: Near-infrared spectroscopy read through the bottle plus machine learning classifies beer fermentation type and authenticity without opening the container.

title: Predictive modeling using artificial intelligence for sensory panel assessments of customized beer production
summary: AI models trained on production parameters predict trained sensory panel scores for customized beers, cutting reliance on full panel sessions.

title: Predicting acetic acid content in the final beer using neural networks and support vector machine
meta: Zhang, et al. · Journal of the Institute of Brewing · 2012
summary: Neural networks and support vector machines predict end-of-fermentation acetic acid levels in commercial-scale beer from early process variables.

title: Learning algorithms for identification of whisky using portable Raman spectroscopy
meta: Kwang Jun Lee, Alexander C. Trowbridge, et al. · arXiv (later Current Research in Food Science) · 2023
summary: Machine learning on portable Raman spectra identifies whisky brand at over 99 percent accuracy and quantifies ethanol and methanol, even through unopened bottles.

title: Quick insights into whisky: investigating rapid and efficient methods for sensory evaluation and chemical analysis
summary: A linear classifier (OWSum) and a CNN on GC-MS molecular data classify whisky odor attributes and origin, matching or beating human experts and flagging marker compounds like menthol and methyl decanoate.

title: Recent advances in whiskey analysis for authentication, discrimination, and quality control
meta: Okolo, et al. · Comprehensive Reviews in Food Science and Food Safety · 2023
summary: A review of analytical and chemometric methods, including machine learning on spectroscopy and chromatography data, for authenticating and grading whiskey.

title: Machine learning-based predictive modelling for the enhancement of wine quality
summary: Ensemble models on physicochemical measurements predict wine quality scores and rank the features that most influence quality.

title: Wine feature importance and quality prediction: A comparative study of machine learning algorithms with unbalanced data
summary: Compares classifiers on imbalanced wine quality data and identifies alcohol, sulphates and volatile acidity as leading quality predictors.

title: Wine Quality Prediction with Ensemble Trees: A Unified, Leak-Free Comparative Study
summary: A leakage-controlled benchmark shows gradient-boosted and random forest ensembles give the most reliable wine quality predictions when evaluation is done cleanly.

title: End-to-end deep learning for directly estimating grape yield from ground-based imagery
meta: et al. · Computers and Electronics in Agriculture (arXiv preprint) · 2022
summary: Deep models trained on 23,581 yield points and over 100,000 vehicle-mounted images estimate vineyard grape yield directly, comparing detection, CNN regression and transformer architectures.

title: Grape detection, segmentation and tracking using deep neural networks and three-dimensional association
meta: Santos, et al. · arXiv (later Computers and Electronics in Agriculture) · 2019
summary: CNNs detect, segment and track grape clusters in the field with F1 up to 0.91, enabling automated berry counting for yield estimation.

title: Digital Assessment and Classification of Wine Faults Using a Low-Cost Electronic Nose, Near-Infrared Spectroscopy and Machine Learning Modelling
meta: Claudia Gonzalez Viejo, Sigfredo Fuentes · Sensors · 2022
summary: A low-cost electronic nose and NIR spectra with machine learning detect and classify wine faults at 90 to 97 percent accuracy for red and white wines.

title: Machine Learning in Fine Wine Price Prediction
meta: et al. · Journal of Wine Economics · 2015
summary: Gaussian process regression and multi-task learning on Liv-Ex 100 price histories forecast fine wine prices more accurately than ARMA and GARCH baselines.

title: From Words to Ratings: Machine Learning and NLP for Wine Reviews
summary: Transformer embeddings of expert tasting notes predict wine ratings and show that language markers such as complexity and harmony track higher expert scores.

title: Learning to Taste: A Multimodal Wine Dataset (WineSensed)
summary: Introduces WineSensed, 897k label images and 824k reviews plus human flavor-distance rankings, to learn joint representations of wine vision, language and flavor.

title: Multiclass classification of diseased grape leaf identification using deep convolutional neural network (DCNN) classifier
summary: A deep CNN classifies grapevine leaf images into healthy and diseased classes such as black rot, esca and leaf blight for early vineyard disease detection.

title: Predicting Wine Quality Under Changing Climate: An Integrated Approach Combining Machine Learning, Statistical and Climatic Analysis
summary: Combines machine learning with statistical and climatic analysis to predict wine quality as the climate shifts, modelling how climatic factors, region and viticultural practice interact.

title: AI-driven 5G IoT e-nose for whiskey classification
summary: An electronic-nose sensor array streamed over 5G IoT, with learning algorithms classifying whiskies from their volatile profile.
